entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It's just... not working.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, I think it's a fault. It's supposed to connect to my phone, right? Well, it won't sync at all. I've tried everything I can think of. I'm just not very good with this stuff.
I see. So it's not syncing with your VeloFit app. I understand that can be frustrating.
Yes, exactly! I feel like it must be broken. It seems like a defective unit or something. The website was a bit confusing when I bought it... I don't know. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly help you with this. Let me just pull up your account. I see the order here... you received it 44 days ago. One moment while I review our policy for you.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.

Alright, I've got it here. Our policy states that any item can be returned within 90 days of delivery if it's in its original condition, and that definitely covers a defective device. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's a relief! So I can return it for a refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 90-day window, I can go ahead and process a full return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on your account right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow, that's amazing. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried.
It's my pleasure to help. Once we receive the band, we'll process your refund immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
